statement: For AHC001 rectangle packing with SA, multi-restart (3x3s) with randomized greedy initialization does not improve over a single long SA run (1x9s). SA convergence time dominates over starting-point diversity.
regime: N<=200, 10s time limit, 10000x10000 grid, linear cooling T0=0.01, 8-move uniform SA
mechanism: SA moves 6 (expand-to-limit) and 7 (target-aware resize) are effective at restructuring the layout, making the initial greedy ordering largely irrelevant after sufficient SA time. Splitting the SA budget into shorter runs reduces per-run convergence quality, approximately offsetting any benefit from exploring different starting configurations.
applicability_bounds: Applies to this specific SA design with 8 uniform moves including expand-to-limit. May not hold for SA variants with weaker exploration moves (e.g., only boundary shifts) where the starting point would matter more.
